skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Guides Twitter/X automation through the inference.sh CLI for posting, media posts, engagement actions, direct messages, follows, and lookups.
skill.summary: Use inference.sh CLI apps to manage Twitter/X posting and engagement workflows.
skill.author: inference-sh

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation-style, but it directs users and agents to execute external inference.sh commands that can modify an authenticated X account. The remote installer pattern on line 22 is a confirmed critical risk, while many Markdown backtick hits are false positives for fences or app identifiers. Semantic review also found abuse risk from automated posting, DMs, follows, likes, retweets, and deletes without explicit safeguards.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell command with a verified package install, checksum validation, and a separate login step.

remediation.issue: Authenticated X actions can run without approval gates.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before post, DM, follow, like, retweet, or delete actions.

remediation.issue: The skill lacks rate-limit and platform policy guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Document rate limits, anti-spam expectations, consent requirements, and prohibited automation patterns.

remediation.issue: Generated media workflows do not include content or rights checks.
remediation.suggestion: Add review steps for media ownership, safety, accessibility, and brand compliance before publishing.

semantic_findings.title: Automated Social Media Abuse Potential
semantic_findings.description: The skill advertises social media automation, engagement bots, and audience growth, then exposes posting, likes, retweets, DMs, follows, and deletes. Without safeguards, these actions can enable spam, platform manipulation, or unwanted contact.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The stated use cases and app list explicitly include engagement automation and account actions. The risk is semantic because abuse depends on how the workflow is used.

semantic_findings.title: Authenticated Account Actions Lack Safety Controls
semantic_findings.description: The examples perform DMs, follows, deletes, posts, and media workflows without documented approval gates, dry runs, rate limits, or policy checks. Accidental execution could publish, delete, or contact users from an authenticated account.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited examples show account-changing commands and no nearby safeguards. The risk is high because these actions affect public content and private messaging.

content.value_statement: Social teams often repeat posting and engagement tasks across X accounts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh commands for posting, engagement, DMs, follows, and profile lookups.
actual_capabilities: Runs inference.sh app commands for posting text tweets.
Creates X posts that reference media URLs.
Likes, retweets, deletes, and retrieves posts by ID.
Sends direct messages and follows users by account identifier.
Fetches user profiles and post details through inference.sh apps.
Shows workflows for posting generated images or videos.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI, login, and a configured X integration.
Does not include moderation, approval, rate-limit, or policy checks.
Uses external services and authenticated account permissions.
Media posts require accessible media URLs from another service.

use_cases.title: Publish Campaign Posts
use_cases.description: Draft and publish approved X updates through inference.sh app commands.

use_cases.title: Share Generated Media
use_cases.description: Post generated images or videos to X after reviewing the caption and media URL.

use_cases.title: Manage Account Engagement
use_cases.description: Prepare likes, retweets, follows, and direct messages for approved community interactions.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Text Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single approved post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a concise X post about [topic]. Ask me to approve the final text before running any posting command.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a captioned media post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an X post for this media URL: [url]. Recommend concise alt text and confirm before using x/post-create.

prompt_templates.title: Engage With Posts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for controlled engagement actions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these post IDs: [ids], recommend which items to like or retweet. Run only the actions I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Launch Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a guarded campaign workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a launch workflow that drafts posts, checks brand and policy constraints, requests approval, then uses inference.sh for approved X actions.

output_examples.input: Post an announcement for a new API guide.
output_examples.output: Suggested post: New API guide is live. Learn the key setup steps and integration tips in one place. Approval needed before publishing.

output_examples.input: Create a media post from a product image URL.
output: Caption prepared for the product image.
Next step: confirm the caption and media rights before publishing.

output_examples.output: Recommended actions: like the support thank-you, retweet the launch mention, and review the unclear complaint before responding.

best_practices: Review every post, DM, follow, like, retweet, and delete before execution.
Use least-privilege X accounts and keep inference.sh credentials protected.
Check platform rules, brand guidelines, media rights, and user consent before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not run bulk engagement or unsolicited DM workflows without human approval.
Do not pipe remote installers into a shell without independent verification.
Do not publish generated media unless ownership and content safety are confirmed.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to X?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents inference.sh commands that can post to an authenticated X account.

faq.question: Does it require an external account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need inference.sh access and a configured Twitter/X integration.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes an inference.sh app command for sending X direct messages.

faq.question: Can it work with images or videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows media post workflows that use media URLs from generated assets.

faq.question: Does it include safety approvals?
faq.answer: No. Users should add approval, rate-limit, and policy checks before running actions.

faq.question: Why is installation a concern?
faq.answer: The quick start pipes a remote installer into a shell, which can execute unverified code.
